verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents native MCP support: docs describe MCP servers as a first-class extension point ('MCP lets Antigravity fetch structured context directly or execute safe actions'), CLI slash commands to configure MCP, and the Agent SDK letting users layer MCP servers over built-in tools; plugins can also bundle MCP servers. This is first-party documentation without independent hands-on confirmation of MCP plugging specifically. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of MCP server usage in practice, and more detail on setup/config UX.
